items.title: The Easy Eight – “19.15.19”
items.summary: It's still not totally clear why Charlie Manning Walker decided to end his great Chubby And The Gang project and then immediately start a new band called the Easy Eight, but that's what he did. The Easy Eight, formerly EZ8, is Walker's new band, and it's also got members of UK punk and hardcore groups like Arms Race, Stingray, and Last Affront.

items.summary: It's been a minute since we checked in on Photay, aka LA-based electronic musician Evan Shornstein. In fact, last time we posted about him, he was Woodstock-based electronic musician Evan Shornstein. But we're locking back in on the Photay frequency today.

items.title: Grace Elizabeth Harvey Announces New EP Songs Of Devotion: Hear “The Dream Of Common Language”
items.summary: If you're in need of a little calm, a little introspection, a little Laura Marling or Joni Mitchell, then I highly recommend checking out the new single from Liverpool folk musician Grace Elizabeth Harvey. She's released the lovely track "The Dream Of Common Language" to announce her new EP Songs Of Devotion, which is out Oct. 16.
